text.tspan: $489.22 a month for 3 yrs 5 mo, at 6.5%.
Interest accrues daily on what is still owed, so a
31-day month costs more than a 28-day one.
Interest accrues daily on what is still owed, so a 31-day month
costs more than a 28-day one. Assumes every payment lands on
time and the rate never moves — paying late costs the extra
days. The overpayments you set are already in these rows,
which is why the schedule ends early.
